info.name: MOSIP Pre-Registration (Local)
info.description:
Local-dev Postman collection for Pre-Registration HTTP APIs (`/preregistration/v1` on host :9090).

Setup:
1. Import this collection + environment `Pre-Registration-Local`.
2. Start Docker deps (`run-prereg-local.bat up`) and the host app (`run-prereg-local.bat start`).
3. Run **00 - Auth** → Client token (optional, for datasync / officer APIs).
4. Run **01 - Login** → Send OTP, copy OTP from mock-smtp UI http://localhost:8080 (or set env `otp`), then Validate OTP (saves `accessToken`).
5. Run **Create Pre-Registration** (saves `preRegistrationId`).

Notes:
- `preregBaseUrl` = http://localhost:9090 (host JVM)
- `bookingBaseUrl` = http://localhost:9090 (frozen `/preregistration/v1/appointment/**` on the same HTTP JVM)
- `wiremockBaseUrl` = http://localhost:8082 (IAM)
- `pridBaseUrl` = http://localhost:8100 (PRID generator, separate JVM)
- Applicant APIs use `accessToken` (OTP cookie). Datasync uses `serviceToken` (mosip-prereg-client, no INDIVIDUAL).
